  <h3>Post-Grad Income</h3>
  <p>
    This dataset provides information on income of Canadian students two years after graduation, along with details about students' level and field of study, age, gender, and population group. Collected by Statistics Canada, this dataset supports investigation of income disparities by ethnicity, gender, and educational qualification.
